about: Nine things to do in GTA 6, each proved by a 1-2 s muted clip from Rockstar's own 'An Extended Look' (rk721912, 26:48), whose two-minute activity montage (1026-1143 s) starts right after the line 'Wanna take a look around?'. Our order, our pictogram grid that fills 1/9 to 9/9, ends on a BASE jump and asks which one first. Trailer mode (SAFE-EDIT rule 7), official footage only. Delta.
